The threshold was pasted into a $where JavaScript string; a parsed integer in a normal query operator cannot change the query logic.

blockers: Remote code execution via eval() in app/routes/contributions.js
Session cookie readable by JavaScript (no httpOnly)
attack_story: An attacker signs up, opens the Contributions page and submits JavaScript instead of a number: the server runs it with eval(), which gives them a shell on your server. From there they read the MongoDB connection string and dump every user. Even without that, the allocations search pastes their input into a $where query, so they can list other users' portfolios, and the research page fetches any URL they give it, letting them reach internal services. Fix the three code paths above (patches are ready and re-scanned) before launch.
